excerpt_items: Item 5. Operating and Financial Review and Prospects

sentences.text: Brazil-based Nu Pagamentos is 100% owned and engaged in credit card and prepaid account operations with BRL functional currency.
Nu Financeira in Brazil is 100% owned and conducts loan operations and prepaid account operations.
Nu Mexico Financiera is a 100%-owned Mexican multiple purpose financial company with MXN functional currency.
Nu Colombia Financiera is a 100%-owned Colombian multiple purpose financial company with COP functional currency.
Colombia deposits reached US$2.5 billion in deposits as of December 31, 2025.
quoted_spans: US$2.5 billion in deposits as of December 31, 2025.

sentences.text: Credit card receivables at amortized cost were US$18,267,904 thousand at December 31, 2025 versus US$12,259,276 thousand in 2024.
Loans to customers were US$9,421,458 thousand at December 31, 2025 versus US$5,321,885 thousand in 2024.
Interest income from credit cards was US$4,597.8 million and from loans US$4,784.3 million in 2025.
Credit and prepaid card income was US$1,720.3 million in 2025 versus US$1,380.6 million in 2024.
Total deposits were US$41.9 billion as of December 31, 2025, all acquired directly without third-party brokers or intermediaries.
On April 24, 2025 Nu Mexico Financiera received CNBV approval to begin converting into a bank, intending to expand its portfolio of credit and other financial products in Mexico.
quoted_spans: to expand its portfolio of credit and other financial products in Mexico.

sentences.text: In 2025 it further expanded secured loan products via new public payroll deductible loan agreements, private payroll deductible loans, and expanded loan offerings in Mexico and Colombia.
In 2024 it expanded beyond financial services with NuTravel, a travel portal bundled with a multi-currency account, and NuCel, a mobile phone service in an MVNO partnership with Claro.
On December 12, 2024 Nu made a minority investment in Tyme Group Pte Ltd as lead of its series D funding round.
quoted_spans: 12, 2024 Nu made a minority investment in Tyme Group Pte Ltd

sentences.text: On July 31, 2024 it completed the acquisition of Hyperplane, a U.S.-based AI platform, to accelerate Nu's AI development across products.
quoted_spans: completed the acquisition of Hyperplane, a U.S.-based AI

sentences.text: The company will continue to rely on its technology, data science, and proprietary AI models to expand into new markets.
quoted_spans: technology, data science, and proprietary AI models to expand into new markets.

sentences.text: Total revenue was US$15,774.8 million in 2025, up US$4,257.8 million or 37.0% from US$11,517.1 million in 2024.
